node.title: KoalaBear active balanced-core source-witness compiler
node.closure: explicit shifted-lattice certificate semantics plus canonical finite selection
node.statement: For every admissible received line in the deployed KoalaBear MCA row, the named active-v4 bcCertified predicate is instantiated by existence of an explicit finite shifted-lattice balanced-core certificate. The certificate records the original line and affine slope, active MCA lattice and canonical reduced basis, a degree-981104 split locator/support witness, explaining data, balanced depth w=67471, earlier-owner exclusions, and chronology. The first-match cell Z_BC is exactly the slope projection of valid certificates after tangent and Q. Lexicographic minimization selects exactly one certificate per Z_BC slope, so the selected-certificate-to-slope map is bijective and every selector fiber is one. No endpoint component, K3 payment, or row close is claimed.
node.falsifier: A Z_BC slope with no valid source certificate, a valid certificate projecting outside Z_BC, nondeterministic or non-finite selector fibers, or loss of received-line, slope, support, locator, depth, or chronology data.
